extra.description:
The HSBC Advance Credit Card is a perfect match for the affluent who are looking to get the most out of their rewards with the least amount of hassle. 
Maximise your savings with the HSBC Advance Credit Card. With this card, you'll enjoy up to 3.5% cashback when paired with the HSBC Everyday+ Rewards Programme. Even without the programme, you can get up to 2.5% base cashback when you spend above S$2,000, perfect for big-ticket purchases up from the usual 1.5% base cashback on all local and overseas spend with no minimum spend.
Cardmembers also enjoy complimentary access to ENTERTAINER where you can enjoy over 1,000 1-for-1 deals on dining, lifestyle and travel.
The card's annual fee is waived for the first year.
